title: Assess logical and architectural design as one integrated basis
goal: Determine whether the affected combined design can satisfy accepted requirements.
context: System and Architecture Design have produced identifiable work from a reviewed requirement basis.
trigger: The author requests integrated Design Review.
preconditions: The requested scope and relevant project authority are identifiable.

interaction.action: Provide logical behavior, architectural responsibilities, Interfaces, allocated obligations and material realization with their accepted requirement basis.
Assesses the complete affected design and its interactions, including missing behavior or responsibility.
Records findings with their correction owners and the scoped integrated judgment.
Identifies whether delivery planning can rely on that design basis.

expected_outcome: One integrated assessment establishes the design basis or identifies the precise upstream correction without manufacturing per-technique gates.

alternatives.condition: An architectural concern can be resolved within the accepted obligations.
alternatives.outcome: The responsible design author corrects the design and obtains affected integrated reassessment.

failures.condition: Architecture exposes a missing system obligation or changed stakeholder intent.
failures.outcome: The requirement decision returns to Requirement Analysis and affected Requirement Review before dependent design reliance.

failures.condition: An accountable boundary or necessary AR is missing.
failures.outcome: Design completeness is withheld; a delivery task cannot substitute for architectural responsibility.

sources.basis: User-selected requirement-first workflow and one mandatory whole-change Code Review gate. Proposed requirement analysis only; existing product contracts remain active until coordinated adoption. No new Function, AR, implementation or approval is inferred.

Document-based author assessment under the explicit Constitution exception confirms this Scenario as requirement-analysis knowledge. It is not independent review, executed product evidence or workflow activation.
